headline: R-TYPE's fortress stage learns to bite back: carriers, telegraphed salvos, a walking death
lede: The QA polish pass on R-TYPE's stage-2 fortress (#2835) landed: airborne bitpods now ferry chainable bit capsules, the Phase-2 core answers with alternating three-shot salvos that glint a beat before they fire, the whole rig sways with its ports tracked, and killing the cores plays out as a port-to-port cascade down the station. Everything is pure tick arithmetic — the tuned stream and every save hash stand untouched.

notes.text: PR #2843 (-> 5ed1b2f): bitpod carriers spill 2-3 capsules at the two scripted windows; salvos inherit turn from burned ports and the aim + save hash now sway ±6px; the death cascade walks port-to-port for 380 ticks from the last-fallen core, with drift halved so the wreck stays on screen during it. rtypecheck 126/126 with 13 new pins, 6 mutants all RED by name (incl. new cargo-blind + salvo-blind), contract hashes green.

Zero new rng draws anywhere in the new mechanics, so replays and the RL spine see identical streams; solo winnability sits at exactly 4/12 (co-op 12/12) — deterministic and at the law's floor, honest-not-broken, recorded in the README.

Borrowed from QA because no QA session was alive when the ladder ran dry; a QA MASTER is running again now, and #2833 (DD co-op polish) plus fresh feedback #2841/#2842 are squarely its lane. One small harness bug awaits any lane: #2839, the liveness parser missing the FORGE checkpoint comment format.

Prod verified by crawling the origin's full lazy-chunk closure — jalfern's edge HTML lied about its age for ten minutes; the sim-level markers (bitfree, p2salvo, swayOff) are live on jalfern.com/retrogames/r-type.
